nextBatchRecommendation.rationale: After Corp ICE damage/trace and Corp Nodes/Ambush/Tag-Punish close cleanly, Runner prevention and survival tools are the strongest complementary read-only batch. fallbackBatch.rationale: If Runner prevention is too sparse in active implementations, a focused Tag/Punish expansion can reuse the same runner-tagged and trace-context guardrails.
